item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00469","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C15","C09","C04"],"selected_candidate_label":"C15","confidence":0.83,"relationship_type":"structural_functional_template","rationale":"C15 plausibly supplied a material framework for the child's compact statement of defense-reorganization objectives. Both organize the case around modern threats, scientific and technological change, readiness for sudden attack, economic sustainability, administrative economy, and continual modernization. The child appears to condense and adapt that earlier sequence into three enumerated goals supporting institutional reorganization. The legislative-transmittal candidates chiefly share routine letter conventions.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"First, the safety and the solvency of our nation require prompt revision of certain aspects of the present defense establishment","parent_excerpt":"true security for our country must be rounded on a strong and expanding economy...
